findings.message: STREAMINFO says the stream holds 24000 samples, but its frames hold 19904, 4096 fewer.
The MD5 of the audio in STREAMINFO is 0, which means the encoder did not know it; the audio cannot be checked against it.
The first frame, at 0x2070, starts at sample 4096 instead of 0, as in a stream cut out of a longer one.
